Label: Session Summary Filename
Description: Format: {participant ID}_{session UUID}_{export date/time in UTC}. Each session produces 4 files with this base name plus suffixes: .json (summary), _falls.csv, _feedback.csv, _notes.json

Label: Falls Export Filename
Description: One row per detected fall event during the session

Label: Feedback Export Filename
Description: One row per coaching feedback message generated during the session

Label: Researcher Notes Filename
Description: Array of timestamped researcher observations entered during the session

Label: Crash Recovery File
Description: Auto-written every 60s during active sessions. Deleted after successful export or discard. If present, indicates a session that was not properly closed

Label: Participant Study ID
Description: De-identified participant code assigned by researcher before session

Label: Session Identifier
Description: Unique identifier for this practice session

Label: Session Start Time
Description: Wall-clock timestamp of session start (file metadata only)

Label: Active Session Duration
Description: Total active practice time excluding paused intervals

Label: Total Falls Detected
Description: Number of falls detected and recorded by the SiA model during the session

Label: Average Technique Score
Description: Mean technique score across all recorded falls

Label: Best Technique Score
Description: Highest single-fall technique score achieved during session

Label: Total Feedback Count
Description: Total coaching feedback messages generated (rule-based + AI)

Label: System Component Status
Description: Status of each ML component at time of export for data quality assessment

Label: Participant Study ID
Description: De-identified participant code

Label: Session Identifier
Description: Unique session identifier

Label: Fall Detection Time
Description: Time of fall detection relative to session start

Label: Technique Score
Description: AI-assessed quality score for fall technique (0–49: needs practice, 50–69: fair, 70–89: good, 90–100: excellent)

Label: Coaching Feedback
Description: AI-generated coaching feedback about the fall technique

Label: Body Joint Angles
Possible Values / Range: Object with joint names as keys and degree values
Description: Body joint angles at time of fall detection (e.g. knee_l, hip_l, elbow_r)

Label: Participant Study ID
Description: De-identified participant code

Label: Session Identifier
Description: Unique session identifier

Label: Feedback Time
Description: Time of feedback event relative to session start

Label: Feedback Message
Description: Coaching feedback text shown to participant

Label: Feedback Severity
Description: Severity level: neutral=informational, info=positive reinforcement, warn=correction needed, error=fall analysis in progress, fall=fall analysis complete

Label: Pose Quality Score
Description: Pose quality score at time of feedback generation

Label: Note Time
Description: Time the note was created relative to session start

Label: Researcher Observation
Description: Free-text researcher observation (not shown to participant)

Label: Pose Estimator Status
Description: RTMLib pose estimation model status

Label: Fall Detector Status
Description: SiA fall detection model status

Label: Feedback Generator Status
Description: LLM feedback system status (Ovis2.5-2B or Gemini)

Label: WebSocket Server Status
Description: Mobile companion app WebSocket server status

Label: Camera Status
Description: USB camera capture status
